candidates.classification: 95e revisit of the same earlier simulation quest-path dispatch; no new unique historical defect.
candidates.trace: run_core_loop_inner chooses five private quest_path literals from the selected typed fixture lane, open cases and policy decisions, uses the string to derive quest_selected and pass an observation, then matches that string to dispatch direct, generated or activity behavior. The selected branches produce only those five known literals; the wildcard selects activity and no unknown producer or misdispatch was demonstrated. The formatted observation is a later diagnostic text boundary.
candidates.connected_repair: Retain a closed quest-path owner through selection, observation and dispatch, encoding its stable label only for the public diagnostic event; preserve both direct modes, generated discovery/continuation, activity, fixture priority, revalidation and bounded run behavior.
candidates.discovery: partial; all decision owners, report consumers, exact aliases and broader simulation modes remain open

candidates.severity: unassigned; source-derived documented IPv6 loopback admission mismatch
candidates.classification: 95e revisit of the same earlier native URL getter contract; no runtime probe or new unique historical defect.
candidates.trace: CoreLoopConfig validates a credential-free HTTP loopback origin and its error explicitly names bracketed IPv6 loopback. The function parses with url::Url, then accepts host_str only when equal to localhost, 127.0.0.1 or the unbracketed string ::1. Cargo.lock pins url 2.5.8; its exact registry source says Url::host_str serializes IPv6 within brackets, and the source test for setting ::1 expects [::1]. Under that documented native API contract, a parsed http://[::1]:port/ has a bracketed host and cannot match the unbracketed branch, so this specified loopback spelling is rejected. No URL parser, executable, connection, simulator or test was run.
candidates.safeguards_and_limits: The intended loopback-only, HTTP-only, no credentials/path/query/fragment constraints remain meaningful; port and normal local host behavior require their own review. The native source test was inspected without execution. The exact crate archive was checksum-verified locally against the lock, with inspected source and licenses published; unrelated upstream fixture files with local-path-shaped examples are not republished and the complete exact archive remains recoverable from the documented registry URL and checksum.
candidates.connected_repair: Use the native typed host/address representation or the getter’s actual bracketed representation to admit the intended IPv6 loopback while preserving all existing loopback, scheme, credential and origin restrictions; review alternate spellings and URL parsing edge cases without accepting remote hosts.
candidates.discovery: partial; all native URL inputs, address forms, config callers, source/runtime parity and aliases remain open

candidates.severity: unassigned; earlier conditional mechanical-evidence retention question
candidates.classification: 95e revisit of the same earlier trace-cap and quest coverage contract; no new unique historical defect.
candidates.trace: emit_event increments the total sequence and updates the last semantic event on each call, but pushes the semantic key only while the human-facing trace length is below MAX_CORE_TRACE_EVENTS (100,000). The fixture coverage builder later checks those retained keys for exact agent, kind, party and quest identity; validate_quest_coverage requires the resulting evidence booleans. If a required matching event first occurs only after the trace is full and no prior retained matching key exists, its coverage boolean remains false even though the event was emitted; trace_truncated separately reports the limit. The converse false-pass case is not implied.
candidates.safeguards_and_limits: Config bounds population, cycles and population-times-cycles, but whether a supported run can actually emit the cap before a required fixture event has not been established. Exact semantic identity matching and public trace truncation remain safeguards; no fixture, report, acceptance, simulation or runtime was executed.
candidates.connected_repair: Determine the intended bounded evidence policy and maintain required fixture semantic facts independently of the presentation trace cap if post-cap events are admitted, preserving exact party/quest identity, duplicate-event metrics, total count, bounded memory and explicit truncation.
candidates.discovery: partial; cap reachability under admitted workloads, report acceptance policy, all event producers and aliases remain open
